data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (EDGAR ticker lookup, 10-K filter, Wikipedia infobox, then the email with the matching subject and body templates), but it has gaps: it hardcodes dana@example.com even though it lists a recipient parameter, it says "send or discard" when the workflow requires Discard and never Send, it doesn't record the filing period, and it calls the page "full-text search" when the true workflow uses the company search box.
